item.title: Briar Hill — History and How It's Changed
item.description:
Before the cafes and apartments, Briar Hill was a quiet rural settlement. The transformation tells a quintessentially Melbourne story.

What Briar Hill Was Originally

Before it was what you see today, Briar Hill was agricultural land and market gardens. The original residents built the suburb’s foundation — the street grid, the housing stock, the community institutions that still exist in some form.

item.title: Briar Hill Neighbourhood Guide — Streets and Pockets
item.description:

Briar Hill Isn’t Just One Thing

Walk from one end of Briar Hill to the other and you’ll notice the vibe shift. The main commercial strip has one energy. The residential streets behind it have another. And the edges of the suburb — where it bleeds into Greensborough — have their own thing going on.

item.title: Cost of Living in Briar Hill Melbourne
item.description:
Money stretches differently in every suburb. In Briar Hill, here is exactly how far your dollar goes.

Read our full Briar Hill suburb guide for the bigger picture.

Is Briar Hill Expensive?

Briar Hill sits somewhere in the middle of Melbourne’s cost spectrum. It’s not cheap, but it’s not going to break the bank either — assuming you’re realistic about expectations.

The cost of living here reflects what the suburb offers. Location, community, access to amenities — you get what you pay for, and in Briar Hill, you’re generally getting good value for the price point.
